title: fabrika config (.fabrika.jsonc)
description: Every key fabrika reads from .fabrika.jsonc. Each is independently optional and falls to its shipped default when absent; this schema documents the shape of a declared value. Generated by `fabrika config schema --write` — edit the key fragments in packages/fabrika-cli/src/config/keys/, never this file.

$schema.description: Path to the JSON Schema for this file — e.g. "./.fabrika.schema.json". Gives an editor autocomplete and validation for the keys below.

appetiteSizes.description: What each pitch size (`**Appetite:** S`, `M` or `L`) is worth in dollars per epic child. The size is the spending limit a pitch approval binds. Name all three, each positive and rising from S to L. Shipped default: S = 15, M = 35, L = 40.

S.description: Dollars a size-S pitch may spend per epic child.

M.description: Dollars a size-M pitch may spend per epic child.

L.description: Dollars a size-L pitch may spend per epic child.

assemblyRefresh.description: Whether the driver merges the trunk into an epic's assembly branch before the tail enters review and before a child shell is dispatched off it.

onReview.description: What `lane refresh --on-review` does: `off` (declines and merges nothing — the shipped default, and today's path into review) or `on` (performs the merge, so the tail review binds to a head the queue can take). A hand-called `lane refresh` is never gated by this.

onDispatch.description: What `lane dispatch`'s pre-dispatch refresh does before it cuts a child's worktree off the assembly branch: `off` (declines and merges nothing — the shipped default, and today's dispatch path) or `on` (performs the merge, so the child builds and runs its verbs in a tree at least as new as the trunk). A hand-called `lane refresh` is never gated by this.

assemblyReplay.description: Whether a child whose merge collides with the epic run's assembly branch is replayed onto its tip.

onCollision.description: What `lane integrate` does with a colliding child: `off` (abort the merge and refuse — the shipped default, and today's behaviour) or `on` (replay the child's commits onto the tip, keep both sides of a plain keep-both hunk, and send the child back for one review round over the moved range). A hunk that is not a plain keep-both parks under either.

lockfileRegenerator.description: The repo's write-mode command that regenerates a lockfile from the merged manifests. When every unmerged path of a replayed pick is one of `lockfiles` and `.gitattributes` marks it `merge=binary`, the replay runs `command` in the assembly worktree, stages the regenerated lockfile(s), and continues the pick. Absent or null, that collision parks like any other.

lockfiles.description: The repo-relative lockfile paths the command regenerates — e.g. ["pnpm-lock.yaml"].

auditCatalogs.description: Repo-relative markdown paths holding extra smell catalogs for `architecture-audit`'s coverage gate, in the same table shape the shipped catalog uses. Add-only: their rows are emitted after the shipped rows, and no entry can remove or replace a shipped smell. Empty (or absent) means the gate runs at its shipped coverage.

boardVocabulary.description: The statuses, types, priorities, audiences and standing lanes this repo's board runs on. Every sub-key is independently optional.

statuses.description: The status role → label map. Every role is optional and falls to its shipped label.

priorities.description: The priority labels triage may keep.

audiences.description: The audience labels triage may keep.

standingLanes.description: The standing-lane labels; an empty list means every issue homes on a milestone.

campaignAuthors.description: Who may declare a campaign or flip its lifecycle state (`fabrika campaign open` / `fabrika campaign state`), narrowing the repository's collaborator ACL — an entry here still needs `write` or above on the repo. Each entry is a GitHub `@user` or `@org/team`, `@`-prefixed. Empty (or absent) means nobody may declare.

capClearAuthors.description: Who may clear one extra repair round on a PR (`fabrika build clear`). Each entry is a GitHub `@user` or `@org/team`, `@`-prefixed. Empty (or absent) means nobody may grant.

ci.description: What fabrika may assume about the repo's continuous-integration producer.

noProducer.description: What a repo with zero Actions workflows gets: `refuse` (a rollup over no producer is vacuous) or `degrade`.

gateWorkflow.description: The CI gate's workflow filename, as `gh api actions/workflows/<file>` names it — a bare filename, not a path.

mainAlarm.description: The main-went-red alarm: who it wakes, and the label its tracking issue carries.

mention.description: The handles the alarm mentions — e.g. ["@someone"]. Empty mentions nobody and still files.

label.description: The label the alarm issue carries, which is also how the standing one is found again.

codeValidators.description: The repo's own commands that compile and lint its code — `build check --surface code` spawns each. Empty (or absent) refuses UNKNOWN rather than guessing a command line.

configValidators.description: The repo's own commands that machine-read a file no `build check` surface opens — a root config file such as lefthook.yml, or non-JS source such as a .java file — every `build check` run whose diff touches a file an entry reads spawns that entry, whatever `--surface` names. Empty (or absent) leaves such files unvalidatable.

reads.description: The exact repo-relative files this command opens, never a glob — what makes a passing run checkable per file.

containmentVocabulary.description: Which child types are asked for a `**Containment:**` marker, and which values satisfy it. An empty half means the marker is never required.

types.description: The `type:` labels a child must carry to be asked for a marker.

values.description: The keywords that satisfy the marker. Never "none", the reserved declination.

cycleDoc.description: The product-development cycle doc a containment class is derived from, repo-relative.

decisionsDir.description: The decision corpus directory, repo-relative. Write null to declare that this repo keeps no decision corpus.

dependencyReconciler.description: The repo's command that installs what its lockfile pins — `lane integrate` runs it in the assembly worktree after a clean child merge, before the code validators. Absent or null runs no install.

docLeakExempt.description: Docs whose subject IS path hygiene — `build check --surface prose` skips its leak scan on them. Repo-relative path suffixes. Empty (or absent) means nothing is exempt.

governedRoots.description: The repo-relative roots a diff derives the governance namespace over. Must cover .fabrika.jsonc itself — a config cannot un-govern itself.

laneConcurrencyCap.description: How many CLAIMED issue lanes may stand open at once — an active lane no driver claims is idle and counts for nothing. `lane open` and `lane emit` refuse past it, with no override. Write null (or leave it out) for no cap.

machineryLaps.description: Whether an emitted epic machine carries the machinery event class, whose laps are counted apart from the repair budget.

onEmit.description: What `lane emit` writes: `off` (today's machine, byte for byte — the shipped default) or `on` (the machinery `LAP` arms beside the existing ones, each task's lap counter seeded, and lap exhaustion parking on `human:machinery-stall` rather than freezing). The machine is fixed at emission, so flipping this moves no lane already on disk.

parkCause.description: What this repo does with a lane park that names no cause, and with one whose cause routes to the driver.

uncaused.description: What a BLOCKED carrying no `--cause` gets: `record` (the bare park, which routes to a human) or `refuse` (unappended, so every park names why).

driverRouted.description: What `recipe unpark` does with a park whose cause routes `driver`: `refuse` (exit 12, the park routes to a human) or `clear` (the driver clears it on its own --rationale, recorded on the UNBLOCKED).

portability.description: What `fabrika guard portability-guard check` treats as this repository's own. `repoNames` are the product, org and directory names fabrika's shipped text may not carry; they are matched whole and case-insensitively. Absent or empty means this repo keeps no names of its own out — the guard's four other rules are unaffected.

repoNames.description: Names that resolve only in this repository.

reviewFilterExclusions.description: The glob patterns added to the review diff filter's exclusion set, on top of the shipped defaults. Empty (or absent) changes nothing.

reviewFilterUnexclude.description: The shipped default exclusion patterns removed from the review diff filter's exclusion set. Each entry must equal a shipped default's pattern exactly; every removal that nothing re-adds is enumerated in the verbs' output. Empty (or absent) changes nothing.

reviewSubsystems.description: The path-glob-to-constraint rows `review scope` layers onto the class rubrics, one row per subsystem. Additive constraints, never a partition: a path matching several patterns counts under each. Empty (or absent) changes nothing.

items.description: One subsystem: the files its glob matches carry its constraint on top of the class rubric.

pattern.description: The slash-separated glob the subsystem's files match — `*` within one segment, `**` spanning directories.

subsystem.description: The subsystem's name, unique across the list.

constraint.description: The constraint text a reviewer applies on top of the class rubric, printed verbatim in the scope output.

roadmapFile.description: The roadmap file carrying the `## Campaigns` focus table, repo-relative.

surfaceDispositions.description: What this repo does when a surface fabrika reads is missing. Declare only the ids you move; every other falls to its shipped disposition.

table.description: The weekly betting table on GitHub Projects: its cadence, agenda and every threshold its flags read. Leave it out for a working table on the shipped values; declare only the sub-keys you want to change.

cadence.description: How often the table meets. Default weekly. The project's iteration field runs 7 days for weekly and on-demand, 14 for biweekly.

day.description: The weekday the table meets and each iteration starts. Default monday.

sections.description: Agenda sections in agenda order. Default Tails, Customers, New bets, Outside the bets. Must include "Outside the bets", where un-bet lanes land.

agendaCap.description: The most proposed rows agenda prep adds for one table. Default 25.

sizes.description: Each size's dollar appetite. Default S 15, M 35, L 40 (L is per epic child).

S.description: Dollars for a size-S bet. Default 15.

M.description: Dollars for a size-M bet. Default 35.

L.description: Dollars per epic child for a size-L bet. Default 40.

stopMultiple.description: A lane over its size keeps going and is flagged; at this multiple of its size it stops. Default 2. Must be above 1.

asksFlag.description: The ask count at which a bet is flagged onto the next table. Default 3.

stuckDays.description: Days without activity before a lane is flagged as stuck. Default 3.

activeCampaignFlag.description: More active campaigns than this is flagged. Default 3.

fabrikaShare.description: The flagged target share of weekly spend on fabrika's own work. Default 40 percent for the first 4 tables, then 30.

percent.description: The target share, in percent, for the first tables. Default 40.

forTables.description: How many tables the first share holds for. Default 4.

thenPercent.description: The target share, in percent, after that. Default 30.

checkDelayDays.description: Days after ship before a bet returns as `check`. Default 14.

project.description: Which GitHub project holds the table. Leave both out to have `fabrika table setup` find or create one on the repository's own owner.

owner.description: The user or organization that owns the project. Default: the repository's owner.

number.description: The project number. Default: the open project `fabrika table setup` finds by its title, linked to this repository or under its owner, or creates.

triageFacets.description: What each triage facet owns and every label an input can make it keep. A facet declares its ownership as `owns` (a regex) or `ownsLabels` (an explicit set), never both.

values.description: Every label this facet may keep.

owns.description: A regular expression matching the labels this facet has delete authority over.

ownsLabels.description: The explicit set of labels this facet has delete authority over.

uiCapture.description: How a capture of a `uiSurfaces` row is taken: the viewport, where evidence is hosted, the storage state to browse as, and the locales a render can be seeded in.

viewport.description: The capture viewport in CSS px. Defaults to 1280x900.

evidenceStore.description: The evidence store captures are uploaded to. Null (or absent) hosts evidence on GitHub as an attachment.

storageState.description: A repo-relative Playwright storage-state file to browse as. It is a credential — gitignore it, never inline the cookies.

locale.description: The localStorage key the app reads its locale from and the closed set of values it accepts. `review-ui render --locale` seeds one of them before navigation and proves it against the page's `lang`. Null (or absent) renders at the app's default locale only.

storageKey.description: The localStorage key the app reads its locale from.

values.description: The accepted locale values, each the `lang` the page reads back when it renders in it.

uiSurfaces.description: The runnable apps this repo renders, one row per app. An empty list means no rendered gate: no path raises the ui class and `ui render` refuses.

items.description: One runnable app: where its rendered source lives, how to start it, and what it serves.

name.description: Kebab-case app name, unique across the list.

prefix.description: The repo-relative source root whose changed files raise the ui class, ending in `/`.

mount.description: The prefix of the surface namespace this app owns, unique across the list.

basePath.description: Where this app serves its mounted pages, when that is not the mount itself. Defaults to the mount.

command.description: The shell command that starts the app. Must carry a bare `{{port}}` placeholder; `{{port:<name>}}` allocates further ports.

readyPath.description: The path polled for a 200 before any capture. Defaults to `/`.

unreadableCodeowners.description: What a §CP read does when `.github/CODEOWNERS` itself cannot be read: `ship` treats the boundary as absent, `refuse` raises the caller's UNKNOWN. Nothing reads this key today.

workflowValidators.description: The repo's own commands that machine-read `.github/workflows/**` — `build check --surface workflows` spawns each. Empty (or absent) stands on actionlint alone.

reads.description: The exact workflow files this command opens — what makes a passing run checkable per file.
